verdict.rationale: Adyen publishes an official GitHub repository of its API definition files in the OpenAPI Specification standard, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The probe 404s only show the spec is not served at guessed docs-site paths; they do not contradict the repo. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the in-person Terminal API (and the Management API used for terminals) is in the OpenAPI repo, a documented canonical download location from the POS docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository contains Adyen API definition files, represented in the OpenAPI Specification standard
